xmldoc.short_description: Train a discrete hidden Markov model.

syntax.syntax_item: [trans, emis] = hmmtrain(seq, trans0, emis0, Name, Value)

description.p: hmmtrain refines transition and emission probability matrices for a symbol sequence using Baum-Welch iterations.
Name-value arguments include MaxIterations, Tolerance, Verbose, PseudoTransitions, and PseudoEmissions.
